loop_dynamics.cka: centered linear CKA across clips after mean pooling all video or action tokens; null means constant features
loop_dynamics.norms: mean across clips of the Frobenius norm and RMS over all token/hidden elements
loop_dynamics.scope: full-budget pass only; later shallow configurations are excluded
loop_dynamics.updates: exit minus preceding loop exit; loop 1 uses the prelude output

panel: one fixed unpadded midpoint clip per held-out demonstration
